summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, following the seven-step workflow in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (43 tests total). Nothing is committed. Not verified: mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check and formatting checks were not run; line lengths were checked and the type-ignore placement was reviewed by reading the code. Design choice: no separate None or str type check was added, because value lookups on None and plain strings return None and fall through to the SHACLPathError branch.
